definitions.short: Kenaan , a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him
definitions.full: H3667. Kna 'an I. כְּנַ֫עַן 90 proper name, masculine and of a territory Canaan ( ᵐ5 Ξανααν , Phoenician כנען = Phoenicia ; Ξνα = כנע , Hecataeus, see Müller Fr.Hist.Gr.i,17 and others; Egyptian Ka-n-±-na WMM As.u.Europa,205 ff. ; Tel Amarna Kina—na, Kina——i , etc., Bez BM Tablets, 150 Wkl TA 39 ; etymology dubious GFM PAOS Oct. 1890. lxvii ff. ; see also GASm Geogr. 4 f. Buhl Geogr. § 42 ); — 1 as proper name, masculine , son of Ham Gen 9:18 , 22 , 25 , 27 ; 10:15 (as ancestor of Canaanites and Phoenicians; all J); 10:6 (P); 1Chr 1:8 , 13 (from Gen 10:6 , 15 ). 2. a. land, west of Jordan , into which Hebrews came, and where they settled, subduing the inhabitants; כְּנַעַן מַלְכֵי Judg 5:19 , כ ׳מלך 4:2 , 23 , 24 (twice in verse); hence כ ׳מַמְלְכוֺת Psa 135:11 ; כ ׳ישְׁבֵי Exod 15:15 (song in E); compare כ ׳מִלְחֲמוֺת Judg 3:1 ; כ ׳עֲצַבֵּי Psa 106:38 idols of Canaan , i.e. of the former inhabitants; especially כ ׳אַרְצָה כ, (ֿ) ׳אֶרֶץ Gen 44:8 ; 46:31 ; 47:1 , 4 , 13 , 14 , 15 ; 50:5 , 13 (all J), 35:6 ; 42:5 , 7 , 13 , 29 , 32 ; 45:17 , 25 ; Josh 24:3 (all E), Gen 11:31 ; 12:5 (twice in verse); 13:12 (opposed to הַכִּכָּר עָרֵי v b ), 16:3 ; 17:8 (all P) + 40 t. P, Judg 21:12 ; 1Chr 16:18 = Psa 105:11 ; also כ ׳הָאָרֶץ Num 34:2 (P); כ ׳בְּנוֺת Gen 28:1 daughters of Canaan = women of the land, so 28:6 ; 28:8 ; 36:2 (all P); כנען is personified Hosea 12:8 = apostate Israel; כ ׳שְׂפַת Isa 19:18 = the Hebrew language (without evil implication). b. the coast , especially Phoenicia Isa 23:11 ; compare ׳כ מְּלִשְׁתִּים אֶרֶץ Zeph 2:5 . II. כְּנָ֫עַן noun [masculine] merchant (s) (because Canaanites, especially Phoenicians, were traders); — כְּנַעַן כָּלעַֿם Zeph 1:11 ; כ ׳אֶרֶץ Ezek 16:29 (omitted by ᵐ5 B and others Co), 17:4 a land of merchants ; compare כנעני near the end.
